```json
{"targets": [
  {"metric": "gain_db", "op": ">=", "value": 18},
  {"metric": "f3dB", "op": ">=", "value": 25},
  {"metric": "gbw", "op": ">=", "value": 240},
  {"metric": "power", "op": "<=", "value": 140},
  {"metric": "swing", "op": ">=", "value": 1.5},
  {"metric": "vout_dc", "op": "range", "value": [0.45, 1.35]}
],
"topology": "NMOS common-source with PMOS current-source load, mirror-biased from ibias",
"rationale": "Since GBW/f3dB = gain, GBW>=240 MHz and f3dB>=25 MHz cap the gain near 9.6 (19.6 dB), so the design targets about 19 dB with deliberately low output conductance. Short NMOS L and moderate PMOS L set gds_total near 85 uS at CL=500 fF. The load width is sized so Id2(Vsd=0.9)=Id1(Vgs=0.75, Vds=0.9), which centres vout at 0.9 V without a mirror-ratio penalty. Current is about 58 uA plus about 14 uA of bias (IREF assumed 10 uA), giving about 130 uW. Swing is limited by the two Vdsat values (about 1.6 V). Units: f3dB and gbw in MHz, power in uW."
}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (58e-6, 40e-6, 65e-6),  # amplifier current = Id1 = Id2 at the mid-rail operating point
    "L1":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),      # NMOS CS length: sets gm/Id at VIN_DC and intrinsic gain
    "L2":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # PMOS load length: sets gds2 (gain trim)
    "gmid_p": (14.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # PMOS bias-diode gm/Id: sets Vsg (top-rail headroom)
    "ratio":  (0.4, 0.4, 1.0),        # PMOS bias current / IREF (lower bound keeps Mn W >= 0.42 um)
}

VDD = 1.8
VMID = 0.9
L_BIAS = 0.5          # long-channel bias devices for accurate mirroring
GMID_BIAS = 10.0      # gm/Id of the bias NMOS diode / sink


def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec["vin_dc"]
    cl = spec["cl"]
    # IREF is not in the spec; assume the nominal 10 uA reference.
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I, L1, L2 = p["I"], p["L1"], p["L2"]

    # 1) Signal NMOS: width so Id(vgs = VIN_DC, vds = VMID) = I (forward model)
    u1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, L1, vin, VMID)
    W1 = I / u1["Id"]
    m1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, VMID)

    # 2) Bias chain
    #    ibias: NMOS diode carrying IREF
    mb = lut.size("n", GMID_BIAS, L_BIAS, iref, vds=0.7)
    #    pb: NMOS sink (gate = ibias) mirrors ratio*IREF into the PMOS diode
    Wn = mb.W * p["ratio"]
    #    PMOS diode carrying ratio*IREF sets pb = VDD - vsg
    ip = p["ratio"] * iref
    pref = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], L2, ip, vds=1.0)
    vsg = pref.vgs

    # 3) PMOS load mirror (gate = pb): width so Id(vsg, vsd = VMID) = I
    u2 = lut.op("p", 1.0, L2, vsg, VMID)
    W2 = I / u2["Id"]
    m2 = lut.op("p", W2, L2, vsg, VMID)

    # Drain-junction capacitance per device, scaled from a same-gm/Id reference size
    c1 = lut.size("n", u1["gm_id"], L1, I, vds=VMID)
    c2 = lut.size("p", u2["gm_id"], L2, I, vds=VMID)
    cdd1 = c1.cdd * W1 / c1.W
    cdd2 = c2.cdd * W2 / c2.W

    # 4) First-order predictions
    gm1 = m1["gm"]
    gout = m1["gds"] + m2["gds"]
    gain = gm1 / gout                       # |vout/vin| at low frequency
    cout = cl + cdd1 + cdd2
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)             # Hz
    f3db = gout / (2 * PI * cout)           # Hz (output pole)
    power = VDD * (I + iref * (1 + p["ratio"]))   # W, includes IREF and bias branch
    swing = (VDD - m2["vdsat"]) - m1["vdsat"]     # V, headroom-limited

    # 5) Netlist
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)     # signal CS device
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, L2)      # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", pref)               # PMOS bias diode
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)            # NMOS reference diode (IREF)
    n.M("MN", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, L_BIAS) # NMOS sink, ratio*IREF

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain),
        "f3dB": f3db / 1e6,        # MHz
        "gbw": gbw / 1e6,          # MHz
        "power": power * 1e6,      # uW
        "vout_dc": VMID,           # V (balanced by load sizing)
        "swing": swing,            # V
    }
```
